name: Flight 12
summary: Flight 12 was the first flight of Block 3 vehicles and the first launch from the second Starbase pad, OLP-2, a day after a scrub on May 21. Booster 19 flipped abnormally fast after staging, relit only 20 of its boostback engines with most failing within seconds, and hit the Gulf of Mexico at about 1,450 km/h. Ship 39 lost one engine during ascent and flew a contingency profile with a longer burn. It deployed its Starlink simulators but skipped the in-space relight, then made a controlled splashdown in the Indian Ocean.
highlights: First Block 3 Starship and Super Heavy
Booster lost after a failed boostback and landing burn
Ship reached engine cutoff despite an engine out
Starlink simulators deployed with the new dispenser

objectives.label: Ship controlled splashdown in the Indian Ocean

payload.name: Starlink satellite simulators
payload.description: About 37,500 kg in total. Sources describe 22 units, mostly Starlink V3 mass simulators plus two modified Starlink satellites.

boosterFate: Failed boostback and landing burns; hit the Gulf of Mexico at about 1,450 km/h around T+6:20.
shipFate: Controlled splashdown in the Indian Ocean at about T+1:05:26.

sources.title: Starship V3 completes full-duration flight despite booster loss
